g.text: This instruction is only applied to 1 unit of 0054 per machine located at Washing side
a) Consider text direction before applying double face tape ""texts are facing outwards of 0054""
b) Bend the cladding edge at 45 degrees
c) Apply double face tape all over the edges of cladding
d) Installed on the outer surface of Structure leg,
Facing to the furthest short edge of 0541_Table_V2
e) Make sure to press the 45 degrees edge against the Table bottom side
until you have a 90 degrees edge,
and then press along all the adhesive lines to the Structure leg
此说明仅适用于每台机器位于洗涤侧的 1 个 0054 型号部件。
a) 粘贴双面胶带前请注意文字方向，“文字朝外”。
b) 将覆层边缘弯折 45 度。
c) 在覆层边缘粘贴双面胶带。
d) 安装在结构腿的外表面，朝向 0541_Table_V2 的最短边。
e) 确保将 45 度弯折的边缘压紧在桌子底部，直至形成 90 度弯折角，
然后沿着所有胶线将其压紧在结构腿上。

g.onmousemove: ShowToolTip(evt,'5',"0226_M4x8 Socket button head screw Black")
